headlines.snippet: Natanel Shicron is the victim of a shooting attack at a spring in Benjamin; the terrorist was captured in a Ramallah hospital. The terrorist opened fire on visitors near Neve Tzuf, abandoned his vehicle, and fled on foot. Natanel Shicron, a father of six from Eli Zahav, who came to immerse himself before Yom Kippur, was critically injured and later died at Beilinson Hospital. After an extensive manhunt, special forces apprehended the terrorist in a Ramallah hospital after he was wounded by IDF tracker fire. About an hour later, a second terrorist attempting a vehicle ramming attack in the northern West Bank was neutralized.

headlines.snippet: Yom Kippur 2026 (5787): Times for the start and end of the fast across Israel and the world, customs, and laws. The Yom Kippur fast for 5787 will begin this evening, September 20, 2026, at sunset and conclude on Monday, September 21, 2026, at nightfall. Fast start times are 17:58 in Jerusalem, 18:22 in Tel Aviv, and 18:09 in Haifa, varying by city. The fast lasts about 25 hours and prohibits eating, drinking, washing, wearing leather shoes, anointing, and marital relations.
